snippet.title: Ronnie Park - Trailer
snippet.description:
ようこそ、ロニーパークへ！

『Ronnie Park』は、制限時間内におばけを退治してテーマパークを守るアクションアドベンチャーゲームです。
あなたは「ロニーパーク」で働く少女「ルーシー」となって、夜のテーマパークでおばけ退治の仕事に取り組みます。
朝にはパークをオープンしないといけないため、おばけ退治は夜の間に行わなければなりません。
効率よく仕事を進め、平和な朝を迎えましょう。


Welcome to Ronnie Park!

"Ronnie Park" is an action-adventure game where you must protect the theme park by defeating ghosts within a time limit.
You play as Lucy, a young girl who works at Ronnie Park, taking on the task of ghost hunting in the park at night.
Since the park needs to open in the morning, all the ghost hunting must be done during the night.
Work efficiently to finish the job and greet a peaceful morning!


▶Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3759240/Ronnie_Park/

▶X : https://x.com/Bunomimic

Available Summer 2025.
